title: Buffon 2006: two goals conceded, still second
checked: Buffon at WC 2006: 7 games, 5 clean sheets, 2 goals conceded, neither from open play: Zaccardo own goal v USA (1-1, 17 June) and Zidane's penalty in the final (Wikipedia Buffon, Ghanamma, Liquisearch); Yashin Award (Oneindia, Liquisearch). Final 9 July 2006, Berlin: Zidane 7' penalty off the bar, Materazzi 19' header from Pirlo's corner, Buffon tipped Zidane's 104' header from Sagnol's cross over, Italy 5-3 on penalties, all five Italian kicks scored (Wikipedia final, LJWorld/AP, 90min). Calciopoli: Juventus relegated to Serie B and stripped of the 2005 and 2006 titles; Cannavaro left for Real Madrid, Buffon stayed (Wikipedia scandal, Wikipedia 2006 Ballon d'Or). Vote: Cannavaro 173, Buffon 124, Henry 121 (Wikipedia, Topend). Cannavaro also FIFA World Player of the Year 2006 (Wikipedia). Yashin 1963 the only keeper to win it (Wikipedia Yashin, Wikipedia Ballon d'Or). The sanction is stated only as on record against the club; no person is accused. Gameplay: Zidane's penalty (the bar is not possible, so a plain penalty) and Buffon's save, gamecap specs/rob-buffon-2006.json.

lines.text: Two goals. That's all Gianluigi Buffon let in at the 2006 World Cup. And he still didn't win the Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Two goals. That's all Jahnlooeejee Boofon let in at the two thousand and six World Cup. And he still didn't win the Balon Dor.

lines.text: Seven games. Five clean sheets. And not one goal from open play.
lines.say: Seven games. Five clean sheets. And not one goal from open play.

lines.text: The first was an own goal, by his team-mate Zaccardo, against the USA.
lines.say: The first was an own goal, by his team mate Zakkardoh, against the USA.

scene.note: Zaccardo's own goal: the only goal Buffon let in before the final

lines.text: The second, Zidane's penalty in the final. A chip, in off the bar.
lines.say: The second, Zeedan's penalty in the final. A chip, in off the bar.

lines.text: Materazzi heads Italy level. Then, extra time.
lines.say: Matterattsee heads Italy level. Then, extra time.

scene.note: Materazzi 19' · a header from Pirlo's corner

lines.text: A hundred and four minutes. Zidane's header is going in. Buffon tips it over.
lines.say: A hundred and four minutes. Zeedan's header is going in. Boofon tips it over.

lines.text: Penalties. Italy score all five, and win it five-three.
lines.say: Penalties. Italy score all five, and win it five three.

lines.text: World champions. And Buffon wins the Yashin Award as the best keeper there.
lines.say: World champions. And Boofon wins the Yashin Award as the best keeper there.

lines.text: Back home, Juventus are relegated in the Calciopoli scandal, and stripped of two titles.
lines.say: Back home, Yooventus are relegated in the Kalchohpohlee scandal, and stripped of two titles.

scene.headline: Juventus sent down to Serie B
scene.standfirst: The champions are relegated and stripped of their 2005 and 2006 titles after the Calciopoli scandal.

lines.text: Cannavaro leaves for Real Madrid. Buffon stays, in Serie B.
lines.say: Kannahvaroh leaves for Rayal Madrid. Boofon stays, in Serie B.

lines.text: The Ballon d'Or goes to Cannavaro. Buffon is second, forty-nine points behind.
lines.say: The Balon Dor goes to Kannahvaroh. Boofon is second, forty nine points behind.

lines.text: Only one keeper has ever won it: Lev Yashin, in 1963. Buffon never got closer.
lines.say: Only one keeper has ever won it. Lev Yashin, in nineteen sixty three. Boofon never got closer.

lines.text: Two goals all tournament, and it still wasn't enough. That's the robbery.
lines.say: Two goals all tournament, and it still wasn't enough. That's the robbery.
